source_section: Exploratory data analysis and removal of cellular contaminations; Identification of a lowly active T cell subpopulation
interpretation: Supplied condition-group-processed, covariate-regressed/scaled HVG coordinates; not a common unregressed log-count space.
permitted_claim: Conditional donor transfer in the supplied coordinates. Fold-local re-standardization checks only the benchmark-added affine step.
excluded_claim: Strictly inductive from raw cells, absolute activation magnitude, or biological enrichment inferred from pooled T2 coordinates.
raw_access: Source study raw scRNA-seq: EGA EGAD00001008197; genotype access is a different dataset.
